title: Next Moca Runtime Defense for AI Agents

api_key.description: Needlepath API key. Use an AI Studio $SECRET/name reference so the key is resolved by Studio and never committed to configuration. Takes precedence over api_key_env when both are set.

api_key_env.description: Name of the gateway environment variable holding the Needlepath API key.

mode.description: Delivery policy for a Next Moca response. Start with shadow.

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum selected context tokens requested from Needlepath.

capacity_tokens.description: Available downstream model-input capacity after prompt and output reservations.

autochunk.description: Split oversized candidate messages into structure-aware records before selection, then map selected excerpts back to their original message.

verify_literal_excerpts.description: Require every hosted selected excerpt to occur verbatim in its original candidate message before the plugin rewrites a request.

timeout_ms.description: Per-request hosted Needlepath timeout in milliseconds.

on_selection_error.description: In quarantine and enforce, what to do when the hosted call fails (bad key, quota, rate limit, oversize, timeout, transport, contract). pass sends the original request upstream; block refuses it with 503.

unsupported_shape.description: In quarantine and enforce, what to do with a chat request the plugin cannot govern (content arrays, function-role messages, duplicate JSON keys). pass sends the original request upstream; block refuses it with 422.

breaker_failures.description: Consecutive timeouts, transport errors, or 5xx responses that open the circuit breaker.

breaker_cooldown_ms.description: How long the circuit stays open before one probe request is allowed, in milliseconds.

telemetry_enabled.description: Emit content-free decision receipts to the plugin process log.
